t3_rtx_vulkan_queued.c_hdr10: Untestable on available hardware. The workstation's only monitor is an SDR panel (the author, 2026-10-17), so the Vulkan surface offers no HDR10 colour space: on the run it offered 5 format and colour-space pairs, none of them A2B10G10R10 with HDR10_ST2084, and the host skipped (exit 77). The check needs an HDR-capable display. Since fix/vk-offered-formats the host names the offered pairs when it refuses a request, which documents an SDR-only surface.
t3_rtx_vulkan_queued.correction: 2026-10-17: an earlier version of this entry suggested Windows HDR was switched off. That was a guess and it was wrong: the panel has no HDR. Corrected on the author's information.

does_not_prove: Pacing on Vulkan hardware or on a Steam Deck; HDR10 through a Vulkan swapchain; that any compositor presents at the reported rate. A refresh value is what the system reports, not a measurement of presents.
